groups.defect: The unguarded awaited retry-count update in the catch block can throw and abort processing of the remaining reminders.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same error-path database write escaping the per-reminder catch. Guarding that write resolves both reports.

groups.defect: The retry-exhaustion deletion branch lacks an SMS method filter and can delete reminders belonging to other methods.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same unscoped OR branch. The shared schema and missing date bound provide context for the same deletion-scope defect; adding the SMS filter addresses both.
